title: Rules
description: Who decides what applies: the judge that reads every pack's rules as data and says whether a change applies, waits for a person or is refused, naming the rule; who may do what, on whose authority, the workspace's standing, and what a drawing may ask. A root pack, started after the loader.

rules.say: "{title}" is a floor rule, which only tightens: {loosens}. The floor changes in code (packs/rules/kernel/floor.ts).
An agent's change to the rule "{title}" waits for the owner: rules decide what waits.
rules.stake: a rule changed decides what applies, waits or is refused for every change after it
